Historical leader was selected from noisy previous data; this shortlist is not a global oracle.

limits: Checkpoint acceptance verifies mechanics/correctness, never a speedup threshold.

Shortlist ranks and profiler/runtime disagreements are exploratory and do not establish physical-kernel causality.
